1.web: Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
1.asv: O Israel, return unto Jehovah thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.

2.web: Take words with you, and return to Yahweh. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good: so we offer our lips like bulls.
2.asv: Take with you words, and return unto Jehovah: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and accept that which is good: so will we render as bullocks the offering of our lips.

3.web: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”
3.asv: Assyria shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods; for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.

4.web: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from him.
4.asv: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely; for mine anger is turned away from him.

5.web: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
5.asv: I will be as the dew unto Israel; he shall blossom as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

6.web: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
6.asv: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive-tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

7.web: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.
7.asv: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the grain, and blossom as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

8.web: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green fir tree; from me your fruit is found.”
8.asv: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have answered, and will regard him: I am like a green fir-tree; from me is thy fruit found.

9.web: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them; But the rebellious stumble in them.
9.asv: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? prudent, that he may know them? for the ways of Jehovah are right, and the just shall walk in them; but transgressors shall fall therein.
